title: Stop setting yourself on fire to keep others warm. 🔥
paragraphs: Stop setting yourself on fire to keep others warm. 🔥

Read that again. Your constant availability is not a measure of your worth. It’s a recipe for burnout. True strength isn't just in what you give, but knowing when to withdraw, recharge, and reconnect with God.
You cannot pour from an empty cup. Be a warrior for your own peace so you can serve with purpose, not just presence.
Even Jesus knew the power of solitude. 📖 "But Jesus often withdrew to lonely places and prayed." - Luke 5:16
Are you ready to set better boundaries? Drop an "AMEN" below if you needed this reminder! 👇
